name: jr-quota
description: Balances of the other paid APIs you use (OpenRouter, Firecrawl, DeepSeek), checked every 10 minutes: /jrquota details shows them all, /jrquota hides or shows the band; a band and a toast appear only when one runs low.

openrouterKey.title: OpenRouter management key
openrouterKey.description: Empty reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY. The credits endpoint needs a management key.

lowUsd.title: Low balance ($)
lowUsd.description: OpenRouter and DeepSeek balances under this are flagged.

lowCredits.title: Low Firecrawl credits
lowCredits.description: Firecrawl credits under this are flagged.
